Definition: from G4012 and G3077; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).
BiblicalUsage: Perilypos means grieved all around, intensely sad. The rich young ruler heard Jesus and was very sorrowful, for he was very rich, and Herod was exceeding sorry at the Baptist's head — yet for his oath's sake he would not refuse it.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that sorrow alone saves no one: the ruler grieved and went away, and Herod grieved and killed — and grief without turning is only pain.
